fact: A survey of 22 mayors in Bejaia wilaya (2017-2021) found unequal connectivity between communes and named the absence of fibre optic in some municipalities as a main infrastructure obstacle.
title: Le Numérique au Service du Territoire : Perceptions et Pratiques Communales dans la Wilaya de Bejaïa (2017-2021)
publisher: Science, Education and Innovations in the Context of Modern Problems (SEI)
